definitions.explanation: A medical term for inflammation of the skin, covering a range of conditions such as eczema, contact dermatitis, and atopic dermatitis. Used in medical contexts and health reporting.

examples.japanese: {手|て}に{皮膚炎|ひふえん}ができた。
examples.english: I developed dermatitis on my hands.

examples.japanese: アトピー{性|せい}{皮膚炎|ひふえん}は{子供|こども}に{多|おお}い。
examples.english: Atopic dermatitis is common in children.

examples.japanese: {医者|いしゃ}は{接触|せっしょく}{性|せい}{皮膚炎|ひふえん}と{診断|しんだん}して{薬|くすり}を{出|だ}してくれた。
examples.english: The doctor diagnosed contact dermatitis and prescribed some medicine.

notes:
Composed of {皮膚|ひふ} (skin) and {炎|えん} (inflammation). The suffix {〜炎|えん} attaches to body parts to form the names of inflammatory conditions, as in {肺炎|はいえん} (pneumonia) and {胃炎|いえん} (gastritis).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {皮膚炎|ひふえん}になる: to develop dermatitis
- {皮膚炎|ひふえん}を{起|お}こす: to cause/trigger dermatitis
- アトピー{性|せい}{皮膚炎|ひふえん}: atopic dermatitis
- {接触|せっしょく}{性|せい}{皮膚炎|ひふえん}: contact dermatitis
- {皮膚炎|ひふえん}の{治療|ちりょう}: treatment of dermatitis

RELATED WORDS:
- {皮膚|ひふ}: skin
- {湿疹|しっしん}: eczema, rash — often used interchangeably in everyday speech, but more specifically refers to the visible lesions
- {炎症|えんしょう}: inflammation — the general medical term
- かぶれ: skin rash (from contact with an irritant) — a more colloquial term
